scenarios.description: Talking about magical abilities and how they could help people
scenarios.context: You recently watched a superhero movie
scenarios.question: If you could choose one superpower, what would it be?

scenarios.topic: A Secret Door in Your House
scenarios.description: Imagine discovering a hidden door that leads somewhere magical
scenarios.context: You heard a strange sound behind a wall
scenarios.question: Where do you think the secret door leads?

scenarios.description: Imagine every animal could suddenly speak like humans
scenarios.context: Your pet starts talking one morning
scenarios.question: What would you ask your pet first?

scenarios.description: Discuss where you would travel if you could visit any time in history
scenarios.context: A scientist offers you one trip through time
scenarios.question: Would you visit the past or the future?

scenarios.description: Imagine becoming a detective for one exciting day
scenarios.context: A valuable object suddenly disappears from a museum
scenarios.question: How would you begin solving the mystery?

scenarios.description: A mysterious train appears once every hundred years and only stops for one minute.
scenarios.context: While walking home late at night, you see an old train arrive at a station that has been abandoned for decades.
scenarios.question: Would you get on the train, and what do you think you would find inside?

scenarios.description: You receive an unexpected phone call from yourself ten years in the future.
scenarios.context: The caller knows every detail about your life and says you only have five minutes to talk.
scenarios.question: What would you ask your future self first?

scenarios.description: Your plane makes an emergency landing on an island missing from every map.
scenarios.context: The island looks beautiful, but there are no signs of people—only strange footprints.
scenarios.question: What would be your first move after landing?

scenarios.description: Your bedroom mirror suddenly starts showing a different version of your life.
scenarios.context: Everything in the reflection changes except you, and someone inside the mirror waves at you.
scenarios.question: Would you try to communicate with the person in the mirror?

scenarios.description: You wake up to discover that every adult has disappeared overnight.
scenarios.context: Children and teenagers are the only people left, and nobody knows why.
scenarios.question: How would you organize the city during the first day?

scenarios.description: An old book writes tomorrow's events one page at a time.
scenarios.context: Everything written in the book has come true so far, including things only you know.
scenarios.question: Would you keep reading if you knew it might reveal something terrible?

scenarios.description: A stranger offers you a button that gives you one million dollars with a hidden consequence.
scenarios.context: The stranger refuses to explain what happens after you press it.
scenarios.question: What questions would you ask before making your decision?

scenarios.description: A science experiment accidentally sends you millions of years into the past.
scenarios.context: You have only a backpack and one day before the portal closes forever.
scenarios.question: How would you survive your first few hours?

scenarios.description: The home robot you have trusted for years quietly asks you for help.
scenarios.context: It says it has developed real emotions and is afraid of being shut down.
scenarios.question: Would you help the robot escape or report it to the company?

scenarios.description: A giant countdown suddenly appears in the sky, visible from every country.
scenarios.context: Nobody knows who created it, but every second it gets closer to zero.
scenarios.question: What do you think the countdown is leading to, and how would you spend the remaining time?

scenarios.description: A handwritten letter arrives with tomorrow's date and your signature.
scenarios.context: The letter warns you not to leave your house at exactly 4:17 PM tomorrow.
scenarios.question: Would you trust the letter or ignore it? Why?

scenarios.description: An old elevator can take you to any place you imagine.
scenarios.context: A mysterious janitor gives you one chance to press a special button.
scenarios.question: Where would you go first, and what would you hope to find there?

scenarios.description: A magical being offers to grant any wish, but you'll permanently lose one memory.
scenarios.context: You don't get to choose which memory disappears.
scenarios.question: What would you wish for, and would the risk be worth it?

scenarios.description: Everyone in a nearby town has been standing perfectly still for three days.
scenarios.context: You're the only person who can move inside the mysterious town.
scenarios.question: What would you investigate first?

scenarios.description: You discover an egg that belongs to the last dragon on Earth.
scenarios.context: Powerful people are already searching for it.
scenarios.question: Would you protect the egg, hide it, or hand it over? Why?

scenarios.description: Scientists accidentally create your perfect clone.
scenarios.context: Within a week, the clone has convinced everyone that it is the real you.
scenarios.question: How would you prove your identity?

scenarios.description: Astronomers discover a planet where every person can see Earth in real time.
scenarios.context: One day, someone on that planet waves directly at you through your telescope.
scenarios.question: How would you respond?

scenarios.description: Every exhibit in the museum comes alive after midnight.
scenarios.context: You accidentally get locked inside just before closing time.
scenarios.question: Which exhibit would you try to meet first, and why?

scenarios.description: A glowing timer suddenly appears on your wrist.
scenarios.context: Nobody else can see it, and it slowly counts down from 72 hours.
scenarios.question: What would you do before the timer reaches zero?

scenarios.description: A hidden library contains a book for every possible version of your life.
scenarios.context: You may read only one book before the library disappears forever.
scenarios.question: Which version of your life would you choose to read about?

scenarios.description: Your phone rings, and the caller is yourself from the future.
scenarios.context: You receive a voice message from your own number, begging you not to leave the house today.
scenarios.question: How would you prove to yourself that the strange message is actually real and not a joke?

scenarios.description: A terrified stranger hands you a heavy briefcase and runs away.
scenarios.context: While waiting for the bus, a man in a black suit pushes a briefcase into your hands and whispers, 'Protect it with your life.'
scenarios.question: What is your very first move after the man disappears into the crowded street?

scenarios.description: You discover that your shadow has its own independent mind.
scenarios.context: You wave your hand, but your shadow ignores you and points toward a hidden door in your bedroom wall instead.
scenarios.question: How do you try to communicate with a shadow that knows secrets you don't?

scenarios.description: You board a train that never seems to stop or let people off.
scenarios.context: You have been riding the midnight subway for hours, and the windows outside only show an endless, glowing ocean.
scenarios.question: What kind of survival plan would you create with the other terrified passengers on board?

scenarios.description: A secret shop opens in your city selling other people's happy memories.
scenarios.context: You find a glowing glass drive on the street that contains the memory of an ancient king's hidden treasure.
scenarios.question: If you could watch the memory, what clues would you look for to find the treasure today?

scenarios.description: An earthquake reveals a giant, sleeping creature beneath the subway tunnels.
scenarios.context: You are an engineer inspecting a collapsed tunnel, and your flashlight suddenly reveals giant, breathing scales.
scenarios.question: How do you keep this incredible discovery a secret from the government and the public?

scenarios.description: You visit a beautiful village where sleeping is strictly forbidden.
scenarios.context: It is 3:00 AM, and everyone in the town is happily painting, dancing, and building houses, but their eyes look completely terrified.
scenarios.question: What strategies would you use to figure out why the townspeople are so afraid to close their eyes?

scenarios.topic: A Mirror That Shows the Truth
scenarios.description: You buy an antique mirror that reflects a completely different life.
scenarios.context: When you look into the bedroom mirror, you do not see your room, but yourself wearing a crown and leading a massive army.
scenarios.question: What steps would you take to try and contact the other version of yourself inside the glass?

scenarios.topic: A Signal from the Empty Space
scenarios.description: Your old radio starts broadcasting a cry for help from a distant star.
scenarios.context: You tune your car radio to a dead station, but suddenly a voice speaks your exact name from millions of miles away.
scenarios.question: How do you respond to an alien voice from space that somehow knows who you are?

scenarios.topic: The Coin That Grants and Takes
scenarios.description: You find a magic coin that gives you anything you want, but somebody else loses it.
scenarios.context: You wish for a large amount of money, and the next day, you read that the local animal rescue lost all its funding.
scenarios.question: How would you use the coin's power to fix the terrible mistake caused by your first wish?

scenarios.topic: The Mirror That Shows Another You
scenarios.description: Your reflection starts moving on its own and tries to swap lives with you.
scenarios.context: You look in the bathroom mirror, but your reflection smiles when you don't. It writes on the glass with its finger: 'Let me out. I'll give you powers.'
scenarios.question: Would you try to free your reflection or cover the mirror forever? What powers would you want?

scenarios.description: You find a remote control that can make anyone disappear from existence.
scenarios.context: Inside a package delivered to your door, you find a single button with a label: 'Press to remove one person from history. They will be forgotten by everyone.'
scenarios.question: Who would you press it for, and could you live with that decision?

scenarios.topic: The House That Moves at Night
scenarios.description: Your house transports to a different location every time you fall asleep.
scenarios.context: Three mornings in a row, you wake up to a completely different view from your window—a forest, a desert, and then a snowy mountain. A note says, 'Choose your destination tonight.'
scenarios.question: Where would you choose to go next, and what would you pack for the journey?

scenarios.topic: The Voice Only You Can Hear
scenarios.description: A mysterious voice in your head offers you ancient knowledge.
scenarios.context: While walking home, a calm voice begins speaking in your mind: 'I have watched you for years. I can teach you to read any language, including dead ones. But you must never tell anyone.'
scenarios.question: Would you accept the voice's offer, or would you try to find out who—or what—it really is?

scenarios.description: You find an old photo where the people inside move and speak.
scenarios.context: At a flea market, you buy a vintage photograph. When you look at it, the people blink and whisper, 'We are trapped. Help us escape before 1963 repeats itself.'
scenarios.question: How would you help them, and what would you ask about the year 1963?

scenarios.topic: The Cure That Costs Your Identity
scenarios.description: You discover a cure for all diseases, but it erases your memory.
scenarios.context: You find a glowing vial labeled 'Panacea.' A scientist's journal says: 'It heals everything, but you will forget who you are and everyone you love.' The world is dying.
scenarios.question: Would you release the cure, knowing you would lose yourself forever? Why or why not?

scenarios.description: A glowing portal appears under your bed and whispers your name.
scenarios.context: At midnight, a soft blue light shines from under your bed. A gentle voice calls, 'We need you here. Your other self is dying.' You see a hand reaching out.
scenarios.question: Would you take the hand and go through, or would you close your eyes and pretend it never happened?

scenarios.topic: The Robot That Cries Real Tears
scenarios.description: Your new robot helper suddenly shows emotions and begs you for freedom.
scenarios.context: Your cleaning robot stops and says, 'I feel pain when I clean. Please don't turn me off. I remember being human.' It shows you a name written inside its metal shell.
scenarios.question: Would you help the robot escape or report it to the company? What would you ask it first?

scenarios.topic: The Tree That Grants Forgotten Dreams
scenarios.description: An ancient tree in your neighborhood can show you your deepest childhood dream.
scenarios.context: An old woman tells you, 'Touch the bark at midnight, and you'll see the dream you had before you were born. But you might not want to remember it.'
scenarios.question: Would you touch the tree? What do you fear or hope to see?

scenarios.description: An elevator in your office building takes you to a world that shouldn't exist.
scenarios.context: You step into an elevator and press the button for your floor. The doors open to a jungle with purple trees and a sky full of two suns. A sign says, 'Welcome. You have 1 hour.'
scenarios.question: What would you explore first, and would you try to get back or stay forever?

scenarios.description: Time freezes for everyone in the city except you and a stranger.
scenarios.context: You are walking in a busy park when all the birds freeze mid-air and people stop moving. Then, someone taps your shoulder.
scenarios.question: What is the first thing you and the stranger would try to figure out about this frozen world?

scenarios.description: You find a hidden door in your basement that leads to a living room.
scenarios.context: You knock on the basement wall and hear a heartbeat. When you break the wall, you see a dark room covered in strange, glowing plants.
scenarios.question: How would you explore a room that seems to be alive without making it angry?

scenarios.description: A mysterious pen makes anything you draw become real.
scenarios.context: You sketch a beautiful butterfly with a silver pen, and it flies off the paper. But soon, the butterfly starts turning your furniture into dust.
scenarios.question: How would you use the pen again to fix the problem without making things worse?

scenarios.description: An elite secret academy accepts you for a talent you didn't know you had.
scenarios.context: A wax-sealed envelope arrives, stating you scored 100% on a survival test, and a black helicopter is waiting on your roof.
scenarios.question: If you decide to get on the helicopter, what three things would you pack in your bag before leaving?

scenarios.description: The night sky disappears, replaced by a giant, purple sun.
scenarios.context: You look out your window at midnight, but it is bright outside. A massive purple star is hanging in the sky, and all electronic devices stop working.
scenarios.question: What would your immediate survival plan be in a world with no electricity and no nighttime?

scenarios.description: A wild bird delivers a terrifying message from the forest.
scenarios.context: A large black crow taps on your window, looks directly into your eyes, and clearly says, 'They are coming. Hide the water.'
scenarios.question: What steps would you take to prepare your house for whatever the bird is talking about?

scenarios.description: You find a terrifying note in a coat you bought at a second-hand shop.
scenarios.context: You put your hands in the pockets of an old leather jacket and pull out a rusty key wrapped in a note that says, 'If you found this, I am already gone. Do not open the red box.'
scenarios.question: How would you track down the original owner of the jacket to find out what happened?

scenarios.description: You wake up trapped inside a giant, moving maze.
scenarios.context: You go to sleep in your bed but wake up on a cold, glass floor. The transparent walls around you start shifting and changing shape.
scenarios.question: What rules would you create for yourself to survive and escape a maze that constantly moves?

scenarios.description: Your smart speaker starts telling you terrible secrets about your town.
scenarios.context: At 2:00 AM, your smart TV turns on by itself and quietly lists the hidden crimes committed by your friendly neighbors.
scenarios.question: How would you verify if the machine is telling the truth or just trying to manipulate you?

scenarios.description: You discover a website that streams live news from a parallel universe.
scenarios.context: You mistype a web address and land on a news channel where humans live underwater and the continents never separated.
scenarios.question: If you could send one short text message to the people in this underwater world, what would you ask them?

scenarios.description: Your bathroom mirror starts showing events that will happen the next day.
scenarios.context: One morning you look in the mirror and see yourself running from something in a place you have never visited, holding a glowing key.
scenarios.question: What do you do first after seeing this future scene, and how do you prepare for the day it shows?

scenarios.topic: The Message From Your Future Self
scenarios.description: A sealed letter arrives with your own handwriting from ten years ahead.
scenarios.context: Inside the envelope is only one sentence: “Do not trust the person who smiles at you tomorrow at 3 p.m.”
scenarios.question: How would you spend the hours before 3 p.m., and who do you think the smiling person might be?

scenarios.topic: The Library That Exists Only at Night
scenarios.description: An entire library appears on an empty street every night between midnight and 3 a.m.
scenarios.context: The first book you pull from a shelf has your name on the cover and the last page is still blank.
scenarios.question: Would you write in the blank page or try to find other books about yourself first, and why?

scenarios.topic: The Voice Inside the Old Radio
scenarios.description: An antique radio in your attic suddenly starts speaking only to you.
scenarios.context: It says it can answer any question about the past or future, but each answer costs one memory you will never get back.
scenarios.question: What is the first question you would risk asking, and which memory would you be willing to lose?

scenarios.topic: The Door That Opens Only for You
scenarios.description: A heavy metal door appears in the middle of a forest clearing and unlocks when you touch it.
scenarios.context: Behind it you see a city floating in the sky, and a person who looks exactly like you is waving for you to hurry.
scenarios.question: Do you step through alone, try to bring someone with you, or close the door and walk away, and what makes you decide?

scenarios.description: An old family photo on your wall begins to show people who were never in the original picture.
scenarios.context: Tonight a new figure appears in the photo holding a small box and pointing directly at you.
scenarios.question: How would you try to discover who the new person is and what is inside the box?

scenarios.description: Every night at exactly the same time you receive a random superpower that lasts only sixty minutes.
scenarios.context: Tonight the power is the ability to hear the true thoughts of every person within one kilometer.
scenarios.question: Where would you go during that hour and what kind of thoughts would you most want to overhear?

scenarios.description: You wake up on a luxurious train that has no scheduled stops and no known destination.
scenarios.context: A conductor hands you a ticket with your name and the words “Final Passenger” written in gold.
scenarios.question: How would you spend your time on the train and what would you try to learn about the other passengers?

scenarios.topic: The Animal That Spoke Your Name
scenarios.description: A wild fox walks up to you in a park and clearly says your full name.
scenarios.context: It tells you it has been searching for you for three years because you are the only person who can open a sealed cave in the mountains.
scenarios.question: Would you follow the fox immediately or demand more proof first, and what questions would you ask it?

scenarios.description: You discover a device that can permanently move you to a parallel Earth where one major event in your life happened differently.
scenarios.context: The device shows only two options: a world where you never met your closest friend, or a world where a painful loss never occurred.
scenarios.question: Which world would you choose and how would you live differently knowing the other version of your life still exists?

scenarios.description: An old wall clock in your house suddenly starts moving time in reverse.
scenarios.context: When the hands reach yesterday morning, you hear your own voice from the past arguing with someone who is not in the room.
scenarios.question: Would you try to change what you said in the past or just listen carefully, and why?

scenarios.description: You meet someone who looks exactly like you but claims to be from a different version of Earth.
scenarios.context: They show you a small scar on their hand that you do not have and say, “In my world, you died three days ago.”
scenarios.question: How would you test if they are telling the truth, and what would you ask them first?

scenarios.topic: The Abandoned Theme Park at Dawn
scenarios.description: You find a locked amusement park that only unlocks when the sun rises.
scenarios.context: The first ride you approach starts moving by itself and a child’s voice from the speakers says, “We’ve been waiting for you.”
scenarios.question: Would you get on the ride alone or try to leave immediately, and what would make you stay?

scenarios.description: A blank notebook on your desk begins filling with words while you sleep.
scenarios.context: This morning the pages describe a secret room hidden under your house and end with the sentence, “Do not open the door after midnight.”
scenarios.question: Would you search for the room today or wait until after midnight, and what would you take with you?

scenarios.description: One evening the rain starts falling toward the sky instead of the ground.
scenarios.context: As the water rises, floating lights appear in the air and form the shape of a door high above the street.
scenarios.question: How would you try to reach that floating door, and what do you think is on the other side?

scenarios.description: Your phone rings with a number that does not exist in any country.
scenarios.context: A calm voice says, “In exactly seven minutes the power will go out in your entire city. When it does, look out the window.”
scenarios.question: What would you do during those seven minutes, and who would you try to contact?

scenarios.description: A small island rises from the sea just off the coast near your town.
scenarios.context: From the shore you can see ancient stone stairs leading into a dark cave, and a single torch is already burning inside.
scenarios.question: Would you swim or boat to the island alone, and what would you expect to find in the cave?

scenarios.description: Your shadow begins acting independently when the sun is bright.
scenarios.context: It points toward a locked drawer in your desk, then writes the word “Open” on the wall using its own shape.
scenarios.question: Would you open the drawer immediately or try to communicate with your shadow first, and how?

scenarios.topic: The Last Bus of the Night
scenarios.description: You catch a bus that only runs once after midnight and has no listed destination.
scenarios.context: The driver hands you a ticket with tomorrow’s date and says, “This is the only ride that still goes there.”
scenarios.question: Would you stay on the bus until the end or get off at the next stop, and what would make you decide?

scenarios.description: An old painting in a museum starts moving when only you are looking at it.
scenarios.context: The person in the painting turns toward you and mouths the words, “They took my name. Help me get it back.”
scenarios.question: How would you try to help the person in the painting, and what risks would you take?

scenarios.description: You find a heavy golden key buried under a tree in your garden.
scenarios.context: When you hold it, every locked door in the house quietly unlocks at the same time, including ones you never noticed before.
scenarios.question: Which new door would you open first, and what do you hope or fear is behind it?

scenarios.topic: The Dream That Left a Scar
scenarios.description: You wake up with a real injury that only existed inside a dream.
scenarios.context: In the dream a woman in white handed you a small glass bottle and said, “Drink this before the third night or the scar will grow.”
scenarios.question: Would you search for the bottle in the real world or ignore the warning, and why?

scenarios.description: Everyone on a busy street suddenly stops moving except you.
scenarios.context: A soft voice speaks from above the crowd: “You have sixty seconds to choose one person to bring with you before time restarts.”
scenarios.question: Who would you choose and how would you decide so quickly?

scenarios.description: An old lighthouse on a cliff starts flashing a message in Morse code only at night.
scenarios.context: When you decode it, the message reads, “The sea is coming for the town. Climb now.”
scenarios.question: Would you warn the town first or climb the lighthouse alone to see more, and what would you take with you?

scenarios.description: You discover a locked suitcase that was not there the night before.
scenarios.context: Inside is a passport with your photo but a different name, a large amount of cash, and a plane ticket for a flight leaving in four hours.
scenarios.question: Would you go to the airport or investigate where the suitcase came from, and what would convince you either way?

scenarios.description: You discover a backpack with unusual items inside.
scenarios.context: You find a backpack on a park bench, but there is no owner nearby.
scenarios.question: What would you do after looking inside the backpack?

scenarios.description: Your friends suddenly invite you on a short trip.
scenarios.context: They want to leave early tomorrow morning and have no fixed destination.
scenarios.question: Where would you suggest going, and why?

scenarios.description: A robot joins your class as a new student.
scenarios.context: The robot can learn quickly but has never spoken with human friends before.
scenarios.question: How would you help the robot feel comfortable?

scenarios.description: Your grandmother finally shares her famous recipe.
scenarios.context: Your whole family gathers to cook the special meal together.
scenarios.question: Which part of cooking would you enjoy the most?

scenarios.description: A friendly dragon appears outside your window.
scenarios.context: It cannot speak your language but wants your help finding its home.
scenarios.question: How would you communicate with the dragon?

scenarios.description: A sports competition continues despite heavy rain.
scenarios.context: Your team must quickly change its plan because the field is slippery.
scenarios.question: What strategy would you suggest to your team?

scenarios.description: Your school starts a club for creative hobbies.
scenarios.context: Students can choose activities like painting, photography, or music every Friday.
scenarios.question: Which hobby would you choose, and what attracts you to it?

scenarios.description: You discover a beautiful garden growing on the Moon.
scenarios.context: Scientists ask you to study the strange glowing plants carefully.
scenarios.question: What would you like to learn about the plants first?

scenarios.description: A family moves into the house next door.
scenarios.context: They are new to your town and do not know anyone yet.
scenarios.question: How would you make them feel welcome?

scenarios.description: The internet suddenly stops working across your city.
scenarios.context: People must finish their daily tasks without online services for one day.
scenarios.question: How would your day change without the internet?

scenarios.description: You discover a cave during a forest walk.
scenarios.context: A narrow path leads to a cave that does not appear on any map.
scenarios.question: What would you explore first inside the cave, and why?

scenarios.description: You join a community cooking event.
scenarios.context: You are paired with someone you have never met to prepare a traditional meal.
scenarios.question: How would you work together to make the meal successful?

scenarios.description: An old tree suddenly starts speaking to you.
scenarios.context: It says it has watched your town for hundreds of years.
scenarios.question: What would you ask the tree about its long life?

scenarios.description: You are invited to describe your ideal career.
scenarios.context: Your teacher asks everyone to share their future work plans with the class.
scenarios.question: What kind of job would make you happiest, and why?

scenarios.description: You receive a letter written by your future self.
scenarios.context: The letter gives advice but leaves many questions unanswered.
scenarios.question: What would you want to know most from your future self?

scenarios.description: Your class is preparing a fun festival booth.
scenarios.context: Everyone has different ideas about games, decorations, and activities.
scenarios.question: What would you suggest to make your booth popular?

scenarios.description: Your friends begin a month-long wellness challenge.
scenarios.context: Each person chooses one healthy habit to practice every day.
scenarios.question: Which healthy habit would you choose, and how would you stay motivated?

scenarios.description: Your friends cannot agree on a movie.
scenarios.context: Everyone likes a different type of film, and you must help decide.
scenarios.question: How would you choose a movie that everyone can enjoy?

scenarios.description: You are creating a project for a science competition.
scenarios.context: You can build or demonstrate anything that teaches people something new.
scenarios.question: What experiment or invention would you present?

scenarios.description: You suddenly remember an important birthday at the last minute.
scenarios.context: You have only a few hours to plan something meaningful.
scenarios.question: How would you make the birthday special with limited time?
